comment: Every grouping is worked out by the same difference rectifier class: the plus side summed, the minus side summed, the two subtracted and the result clamped to -10V to 10V before being split (LetsSplosh.cpp:69-91, NLCShared.hpp:98-104). The lights are driven from the outputs themselves, so a lit jack is a jack with voltage on it.
